C:P1.1.text: ISG | Global AI-Centered Technology Research & Advisory Firm

C:P1.2.text: ISG is a global AI-centered technology research and IT advisory firm committed to helping clients achieve operational excellence.

C:P1.3.text: Take control of what your technology delivers, however fast the market moves

C:P1.4.text: State of Enterprise AI: The AI Value Gap

C:P1.5.text: AI is creating visible operational gains for many enterprises. However, it's not yet consistently producing business and financial value.

C:P1.6.text: Make the right move, with confidence

C:P1.8.text: ISG combines decades of deal experience, deep provider knowledge and an AI-first perspective to help you choose partners and negotiate contracts that reflect changing capabilities and costs before outdated terms limit your options.

C:P1.9.text: Understand what your technology should cost

C:P1.10.text: Without a clear view of how your costs, contracts and service quality compare with the market, you may keep paying too much or accepting too little, and ISG’s extensive benchmarking data gives you the evidence to decide where to act.

C:P1.11.text: Get the results you expect from your suppliers

C:P1.12.text: Even a well negotiated contract can fall short if performance slips or risks go unnoticed, so ISG combines supplier management expertise with ongoing oversight to help you address problems early and get the results your business depends on.

C:P1.13.text: Choose providers with a clearer view of the market

C:P1.14.text: As AI reshapes service and software capabilities, relying on familiar names can mean overlooking a better fit, while ISG’s independent research and firsthand market knowledge help you understand your options before making a significant commitment.

C:P1.15.text: Your AI strategy, built for what comes next

C:P1.16.text: Every AI decision now affects performance, competitiveness and the future of the enterprise. By the time you’ve finalised your AI strategy, the market may already have moved on.

C:P1.17.text: ISG brings independent market intelligence, enterprise benchmarks and practical advisory experience to help you decide what matters, where to act and how fast to move. We connect AI market shifts to your strategy, operating model, workforce and economics so you can move earlier, avoid stranded investment and keep your strategy relevant.

C:P1.18.text: Choose where AI matters and make it scale

C:P1.19.text: AI strategy is not a catalogue of use cases, it's the choice of where the enterprise will place its bets, how work will change and what deserves to scale. We help you connect AI ambition to business priorities, select the use cases worth scaling and define the operating model, roadmap and partner strategy to move forward. This gives you a clear portfolio of priorities, a funded path to execution and a practical definition of what success looks like.

C:P1.20.text: Put accountability behind every AI decision

C:P1.21.text: Without clear decision rights and controls, pilots stall, autonomous systems create unmanaged exposure and accountability breaks down. Across use cases, models, agents and workflows, we establish clear ownership, classify risk, design lifecycle controls, monitor performance and create reporting that gives you a usable view of exposure and trust.
